parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the control lever of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open and close the water valve, allowing precise control of water output.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet, made of stainless steel to provide structural support and house internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, connects to the water supply, and channels water to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base of the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel for corrosion resistance and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the internal channel to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to adjust the direction of water flow.
